title: The Lacerta files: Swedish documents about reptilians

tellings.quote: amazing piece on the LERA files, these, you know, documents uh from from Sweden about these like reptilians or whatever.

plain: The Lacerta files are said to be documents from Sweden about reptilians, meaning reptile-like beings. Michels mentions them in passing, praising "an amazing piece" on them that he connects with his guest, Chris Ramsay. He gives no more detail about what the files say.
